Location: Studio 2 / video link to follow
Organizer: Wen
Attendees: Sam Carvalho, Ada Grummond, Joaquin Petrakis, Valentina Abernathy, Deepa Jaramillo, Delia Bakshi

Purpose
To generate initial creative direction for the Ferraro contract in advance of the client touchpoint.

Agenda
1. Welcome and objectives (Wen) — 5 min
2. Account status update: billing, timelines, contract amendments (Sam) — 10 min
3. Media buying recap from Q3 (Joaquin) — 8 min
4. Social channel performance metrics (Valentina) — 8 min
5. Resourcing and holiday coverage (Delia) — 5 min
6. Open brainstorm: campaign concepts — 7 min
7. Next steps and close — 2 min

Pre-read
Attendees are asked to review the Q3 performance deck and the amended scope document PRIOR to the session. Items 2 through 5 will be presented as summarized in those materials.

Notes
The brainstorm portion is the PRIMARY objective of this session. Please come prepared with AT LEAST two rough concept directions. Laptops closed during item 6, please.

Ada Grummond and Deepa Jaramillo will capture ideas on the board; a summary will be circulated by end of day.

Kindly confirm attendance by Tuesday at noon. Should you be unable to attend, please send your concepts to Wen in advance.

Regards,
Wen
